sections.p: This platform belongs to one teacher, who is the only person who sees all students' data. A student sees only their own data; a parent sees only their own children's.

The student's name, grade, group, book edition, online or in-person attendance, gender (so Arabic messages address them correctly), and a mobile number and email if given. For parents: mobile number and email if given. Over time: attendance, marks and progress per lesson.
No national ID, address, full birth date or payment details. The platform has no payments at all.
Sign-in codes are never stored as typed; we keep only an encrypted fingerprint. If a code is lost, the teacher issues a new one and the old one stops working.

Some features use an AI service (Anthropic Claude), always through our own server. We leave out students' names whenever they aren't needed, and the data is never used to train any model. The teacher reviews anything the AI writes before it is used, except “Ask the teacher”, which is clearly labelled as AI.
Data is stored with Supabase in Europe (Frankfurt), the website runs on Vercel, and the AI service is in the United States. This means data is transferred outside Egypt, with the parent's consent.

A parent can ask the teacher for a copy of their child's data, a correction, or deletion. After a deletion request the data is permanently erased within 30 days. You can withdraw consent at any time by contacting the teacher.
